description: Create from scenarioId (scenario.list → scenario.get), or resources/connections for a custom graph. Returns id for simulation.step. Never blindly retry a timeout: creation may have succeeded. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.create

ecsCpuTargetTracking.description: Opt into CPU-only ECS Fargate target tracking; requires an AWS Fargate compute resource. Required for scaleOutCooldownSeconds, scaleInCooldownSeconds and top-level simulationSecondsPerStep; other providers keep their existing policy.

scaleInCooldownSeconds.description: ECS scale-in cooldown in simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

scaleOutCooldownSeconds.description: ECS scale-out cooldown in simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

simulationSecondsPerStep.description: Requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Converts ECS cooldown seconds into step counts only (default 1); not a global simulation clock.
